lines.text: Did you know? Spir is Latin for breathe.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus breathe?

words.ex: Her story inspired many young women.
The team showed great spirit in the final match.
What are you two conspiring about?

publish.title: Spir root: inspire, spirit and conspire
publish.value: Spir comes from Latin "spirare" (to breathe). Words: inspire, spirit and conspire. inspire = in + spire; conspire = con + spire.
